art_note: Synthetic 3D mockups with flat lighting and sterile rendering; lacks the tactile depth, editorial nuance, and physical craftsmanship expected of a luxury fashio
desc_en: Engineered with a streamlined contemporary silhouette, these low-top sneakers blend graphic contrast with lightweight precision. The construction pairs a breathable mesh and technical PU upper with an EVA outsole and removable cushioned footbed, providing enduring comfort throughout the day. A refined lace-up closure anchored by five metal eyelets completes the minimalist profile. Exclusively made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Diseñadas bajo una silueta depurada y contemporánea, estas zapatillas de caña baja combinan contraste gráfico con absoluta ligereza. La estructura integra una parte superior de malla técnica y PU para una transpirabilidad superior, complementada con una suela y plantilla extraíble de EVA concebidas para un soporte constante durante todo el día. Su cierre clásico de cordones con cinco ojales metálicos confiere un porte urbano impecable. Confeccionadas bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Technical PU and mesh upper
· Lightweight EVA outsole
· Removable cushioned EVA insole
· Front lace-up closure with 5 metal eyelets
· Clean with cold water; machine washable, air dry
· Made to order
